quality.review_scope: Scoped review of all ten main and ten matching SI pages. Source-specific preparations, analytical sample classes, outcomes, unresolved conflicts and missing fields are retained.
missing_fields: Cited external syntheses of P(SiMe3)3 and ODPA were not inspected; no unreported upstream conditions imported.
Isolated MSC mass includes its ligand set; mass is not converted to moles of pure InP.
Exact physical batch joins between synthesis, NMR, XRD, PDF and optical samples remain unassigned unless explicitly stated.
Atomic coordinates and sample-specific lattice parameters are not supplied.
Late octylamine addition: no numerical final absorption maximum or general 50 °C sampling interval is assigned from the separate early-addition experiment.
